directories.name: Bangladesh Clinical Psychology Society (BCPS) - member lists
directories.notes: BCPS publishes public member tables (ID, photo, name and address, e-mail, area of expertise) under Members: Life Members (?page_id=370), General Members (?page_id=383), Associate Members (?page_id=392), Affiliate Members (?page_id=399). These are membership lists, not a booking directory, and they contain personal emails, so do not copy them. On 2026-09-26 the site's TLS certificate was expired (WebFetch failed; curl -k worked).

directories.notes: Moner Bondhu (Lalmatia, Dhaka; founded 2016) lists 7 psychiatrists with qualifications, but they have no individual profile or booking pages (only the generic /booking page), so none were included.

directories.name: Ibn Sina Trust - Find a Doctor
directories.notes: Doctor schedules by branch and by department for Ibn Sina branches nationwide (Chattogram psychiatry dept id=588, Rajshahi id=703).

notes: Booking works differently by source. Evercare and Square have online appointment-request forms. Moner Bondhu profiles have an online slot-booking widget. Ibn Sina pages (Sylhet, Chattogram, Rajshahi) list chamber times and say to book by calling the institutional hotline, so there booking_url is the official schedule page, not an online form. Ibn Sina Trust pages also say: 'please wait for our contact center to confirm your appointment timing'.

Evercare profile structured data shows the same hours for everyone (Sun-Thu 09:00-17:00), which look like hospital-wide defaults rather than each person's chamber hours. The 'Request an Appointment' button is the evidence that they practise.

modes: 'in_person' for hospital entries is implied by the hospital OPD/chamber setting, not stated outright. Only the Moner Bondhu pages state Online / In Person options explicitly. Evercare links a general 'Evercare Tele' service but not for each doctor, so 'online' was not claimed.

Ibn Sina Hospital Sylhet profile pages leave the 'Specialization' field blank. Psychiatry was confirmed from the published degrees (MD/M-Phil/FCPS Psychiatry) and from the hospital's Psychiatry consultant grouping. Designations such as 'Associate Professor, SOMCH' are the teaching posts they publish, not titles at Ibn Sina.

Also verified but left out to stay within 20 and to keep Dhaka from dominating: from Evercare Dhaka, Mrs. Dill Naz Zohura (Senior Counsellor), Ms. Fabia Alam (Counsellor, MSc Clinical Psychology) and Ms. Tarana Anis (Senior Child Psychologist, no qualifications published); from Moner Bondhu, Kazi Rumana Haque (Lead Psychosocial Counselor, MS Counseling Psychology DU) and other staff titled 'Psychosocial Counselor'.

Skipped: Dr. Md. Fakhruzzaman Shaheed at Ibn Sina Sylhet. His designation reads 'Assistant Professor, Psychiatry (Rtd.)'; a consultation time is listed, but the retired status makes it unclear. Dr. Shaafi Raaisul Mahmood also appears on Ibn Sina Chattogram's psychiatry schedule; he is listed once, under Evercare.
United Hospital Dhaka's psychiatry page (uhlbd.com/departments/psychiatry-behavioural-science) returned 404 to curl, so it was not used.
Popular Diagnostic Centre's site is a JavaScript-only single-page app (a comment in its HTML says it was under attack in Aug 2026), so doctor pages could not be read from raw HTML. Skipped.
Aggregator sites (doctorbangladesh, docbd, sasthyaseba, heliumdoc, etc.) were deliberately not used as sources.
No personal phone numbers, emails, photos, fees or home addresses were collected. The institutional hotlines on the pages were also left out.
